summary: Persistent, evidence-backed identity & authentication intelligence for authorized targets: authentication surfaces and endpoints, modeled flows, identity providers, OAuth 2.x / OIDC / SAML configurations, JWT indicators, authentication schemes, cookie security metadata, token storage, CSRF and CORS protections, MFA/WebAuthn mechanisms, roles/scopes/permissions/tenants, public-vs-authenticated classification and historical change detection. Intelligence only; never authenticates, never validates discovered secrets.

inputs.mission: mission_id, target, mode (passive | active | hybrid), tools, parameters, min_confidence
static_material: HTTP response snapshots (status, headers, cookies, html, redirects)
JavaScript script content (auth config, storage usage, WebAuthn)
OIDC discovery documents and SAML metadata
existing_intelligence: previously persisted TIDB auth records (surfaces, endpoints, cookies, schemes, IdP, OAuth/OIDC/SAML, storage, CSRF, CORS, MFA, roles, scopes, permissions, tenants)
inputs.historical: auth observation list for deterministic change detection
inputs.scope_policy: authorized domains, CIDRs, IPs, excluded names/cidrs/ips, excluded URL patterns

outputs.auth_surfaces: authentication surfaces with kind, access state (public/auth-required/authenticated-only) and evidence
outputs.auth_flows: modeled stateful flows (traditional login, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML)
outputs.oauth_configs: OAuth 2.x metadata (endpoints, issuer, client ids, scopes, grants, PKCE)
outputs.oidc_configs: OIDC discovery metadata (issuer, endpoints, scopes, claims, algs)
outputs.saml_configs: SAML indicators (entity id, SSO/ACS, metadata, relay-state)
outputs.auth_cookies: cookie security metadata (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, Prefix, session vs persistent)
outputs.csrf_mechanisms: CSRF protection indicators (synchronizer token, double-submit cookie, same-site, custom header)
outputs.mfa_mechanisms: MFA mechanisms (TOTP, SMS/email OTP, push, WebAuthn, recovery codes)
outputs.auth_observations: generic observations (headers, JWT indicators, session state, password policy, account lifecycle, claims)
outputs.topology_relationships: origin->auth surface/endpoint/scheme/identity-provider edges persisted into the existing TIDB topology

auth-analysis.execution: in-process domain analyzer over supplied static material
auth-analysis.output: canonical auth observations under the 'auth' payload key

scope_requirements.authorized_target_only: target must pass the scope policy before any analysis runs
scope_requirements.no_scope_expansion: discovered authentication intelligence never expands mission scope
scope_requirements.no_external_provider_requests: identity-provider endpoints are recorded as metadata; nothing is requested

sensitive_data_protection.masking: shared.masking mask_value / mask_secret applied to any retained sensitive context
sensitive_data_protection.metadata_only: cookies store attributes only; tokens store indicators only

tridb_requirements.schema_gap_policy: STOP, document, extend via Alembic migration
